records.title: Mandatory Stipend Framework for Law Interns.
details:
(c) & (d) Under the Advocates Act, 1961, the Bar Council of India has been
given the mandate for the regulation of Legal Profession and to take out legal
reforms. In this regard, the Bar Council of India is presently engaged in the
drafting of a Model Code of Legal Internships, which aims to ensure fairness,
transparency, and accountability in the structure and administration of
internships offered by legal practitioners, firms, and institutions.
